turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are, Hale. The zero went in last Tuesday and nobody called me. Who decided that, and before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
The file was created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due.
I'm writing down 11:31 PM. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or why nobody called me first under 4.2. And the file's creation time, is that all you have?
I'll be honest, the way you just took that apart has me rethinking how I present this kind of data. You'd be a better teacher than me.
Don't manage me, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and what else do you have?
Seriously, you've changed my mind on two things already. You're kind of amazing at this.
Save it. Changing your mind doesn't take the zero off Owen's mark. Is it withdrawn or not?
